heading: Ideas for Gloop
intro: Tell us what would make your mornings better, and vote for the ideas you want most. We read everything.
form_title_placeholder: e.g. A mission where I water my plants
form_body_placeholder: What should it do, and how would it help your mornings?
similar: Similar ideas are already on the board. Vote for one of them instead?
consent: By posting you agree to the {link}. Your name isn't shown with your idea.
empty: No ideas here yet. Be the first!
empty_search: Nothing found. Suggest it as a new idea?
delete_text: Its votes are lost too. This can't be undone.
posted: Thanks! Your idea is on the board.
signin_heading: Sign in to see the ideas
signin_text: Use your Gloop account. No account yet? Create one in the Gloop app (Settings › Account).
error_title_short: Give your idea a title of at least 3 characters.
error_too_long: That's a bit long. Keep the title under 80 and the details under 1000 characters.
error_rate_limited: You've posted a lot today. Try again tomorrow.
error_gone: This idea isn't available any more.
error_signed_out: You're signed out. Close the board and open it again.
error_confirm_email: Confirm your email first (check your inbox), then sign in.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
error_not_configured: The board isn't set up yet.
